verdict.rationale: Skills are a packaging format for Claude, not an MCP client themselves. The surrounding Claude Code plugin system, which distributes skills, can bundle MCP servers alongside skills, agents and hooks (docs-6, docs-21). The Claude Code host also connects to hundreds of external tools via MCP (docs-57). So MCP tool use comes through the companion host and plugin layer rather than the Skills format itself. Missing for 10: a native MCP-server declaration or wiring inside SKILL.md or the Agent Skills spec, MCP support on the Skills API/container path, detailed configuration docs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
